confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge only; no city-price searches, live listings, or booking pages were used. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation tiers vary widely by neighborhood and are set at July mid-year holiday rates including taxes. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor using typical local multipliers because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value was taken from search-result summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates page; that page was not opened directly, and some snapshots had inconsistent timestamps, so confirm against the live RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Latin American Caribbean-coast and colonial-center tourist destinations with similar visitor demand, adjusted to Colombian local price levels. Accommodation tiers reflect historic-center and Getsemaní guesthouse and hostel stock plus beach-strip mid-range hotels.
